confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief to confirm whether LH-02 is actually stopped or operating (radio and CMMS disagree). Nothing moved there until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: Norte is truck-limited (inflow 71 vs 66 t/h) and its stockpile holds 242 t, so a loader for N600-09 adds no hauled ounces. Este has spare truck capacity (33 of 72 t/h). E543-11 has 285 t at 8.3 g/t and LH-05 alone mucks only about 231 t by 17:00. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.2 oz/h, and takes 0.55 h to reach E543-11. It adds about 54 t, or roughly 14 oz, against a cost of about 1 oz. LH-09 is on a critical-path heading (4 oz/h), so I leave it alone. LH-02 is not touched because the radio and CMMS conflict (CONFIRM-01). LH-10 is not available until 11:00. Reserves cannot be activated because no stope has stopped.
